requirements.text: Requesting a reset returns the same response whether or not the account exists
The link carries a high-entropy random token; only its hash is stored
Links expire and work once; expired, used, revoked and unknown tokens fail alike, and concurrent completions let exactly one win
A weak new password is refused without consuming the token
Completing a reset revokes other outstanding links and existing sessions
Requests are rate limited, origin-checked and body-size bounded
A failed email delivery invalidates the link and is reported server-side only
